queries.description: MV key on a scan
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)

queries.description: Two MV keys and one SV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), col2, ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2), SUM(col3) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), col2, ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2)

queries.description: MV key above a join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1)

queries.description: MV key and SV key above a join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT SUM(a.col3) AS sumCol3, ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1), a.col2 FROM a JOIN e ON a.col1 = e.col1 GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1), a.col2

queries.description: MV key in a subquery
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT k, cnt FROM (SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) AS k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)) WHERE cnt > 1

queries.description: MV key with ORDER BY and LIMIT, group trim
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_enable_group_trim='true') */ ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) ORDER BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) DESC LIMIT 10
output: PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[COUNT($1)], aggType=[FINAL], collations=[[0 DESC]], limit=[10])
PinotLogicalMvAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[COUNT()], mvKeys=[[0]], aggType=[LEAF], collations=[[0 DESC]], limit=[10])

queries.description: MV key with ORDER BY aggregate and LIMIT, group trim
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_enable_group_trim='true') */ COUNT(*) AS cnt, ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
output: PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[COUNT($1)], aggType=[FINAL], collations=[[1 DESC]], limit=[10])
PinotLogicalMvAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[COUNT()], mvKeys=[[0]], aggType=[LEAF], collations=[[1 DESC]], limit=[10])

queries.description: DISTINCT on an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT DISTINCT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) FROM e

queries.description: Hint is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by is ignored for an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by='true') */ ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)

queries.description: Hint is_partitioned_by_group_by_keys is ignored for an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_partitioned_by_group_by_keys='true') */ ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)

queries.description: Hint is_leaf_return_final_result is honored for an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_leaf_return_final_result='true') */ ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), AVG(col3) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)
output: PinotLogicalMvAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[$SUM0($1)], agg#1=[COUNT()], mvKeys=[[0]], aggType=[LEAF], leafReturnFinalResult=[true])

queries.description: MV key over an array function
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(VALUE_IN(mcol1, 'a', 'b')), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(VALUE_IN(mcol1, 'a', 'b'))

queries.description: MV key with a leaf WHERE on ARRAY_TO_MV
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e WHERE ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) IN ('a', 'b') GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)

queries.description: Gate off: MV key on a scan keeps the plain aggregate
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=false; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)

queries.description: Nested CAST(ARRAY_TO_MV()) key on a scan is not an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT CAST(ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2) AS VARCHAR), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY CAST(ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2) AS VARCHAR)

queries.description: Nested CASE WHEN ARRAY_TO_MV() key on a scan is not an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY CASE WHEN ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) = 'a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

queries.description: Nested LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV()) key on a scan is not an MV key
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1))

queries.description: Nullable MV key on a scan with column-based null handling
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM f GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)

queries.description: Nullable MV key with ORDER BY aggregate and LIMIT, group trim
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_enable_group_trim='true') */ COUNT(*) AS cnt, ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) FROM f GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
output: PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[COUNT($1)], aggType=[FINAL], collations=[[1 DESC]], limit=[10])
PinotLogicalMvAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[COUNT()], mvKeys=[[0]], aggType=[LEAF], collations=[[1 DESC]], limit=[10])

queries.description: Nullable MV key above a join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(f.mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM f JOIN a ON f.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(f.mcol1)

queries.description: MV key above a lookup join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='lookup') */ ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1)

queries.description: MV key also used as an aggregate argument keeps the plain aggregate
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2), SUM(ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2)) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol2)

queries.description: Gate off: MV key above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=false; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1)
queries.expectedException: .*ARRAY_TO_MV found in PROJECT in the intermediate stage.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: Nested CASE WHEN ARRAY_TO_MV() key above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1) = 'a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

queries.description: Nested LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV()) key above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1))

queries.description: Nested CAST(ARRAY_TO_MV()) key above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY CAST(ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol2) AS VARCHAR)

queries.description: ARRAY_TO_MV in the SELECT list fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1) FROM e
queries.expectedException: .*ARRAY_TO_MV found in PROJECT in the leaf stage.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: ARRAY_TO_MV in a filter above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 WHERE ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1) = a.col2

queries.description: ARRAY_TO_MV in an aggregate argument above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT SUM(ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol2)) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1

queries.description: Plain GROUP BY on a multi-value column fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT mcol1, COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY mcol1
queries.expectedException: .*Use ARRAY_TO_MV\(\) to group by multi-value column.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: MV key and the same column as a plain key fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), mcol1
queries.expectedException: .*Use ARRAY_TO_MV\(\) to group by multi-value column.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: Nested LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV()) key above a lookup join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='lookup') */ COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1))
queries.expectedException: .*ARRAY_TO_MV found in PROJECT in the intermediate stage.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: MV key with GROUPING SETS on a scan keeps the plain aggregate: grouping sets are not supported by the MV aggregate
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)), ())

queries.description: MV key with GROUPING SETS above a join fails: grouping sets are not supported by the MV aggregate
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1), COUNT(*) FROM e JOIN a ON e.col1 = a.col1 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ARRAY_TO_MV(e.mcol1)), ())
queries.expectedException: .*ARRAY_TO_MV found in PROJECT in the intermediate stage.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: MV key with a WITHIN GROUP ordered aggregate fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1), LISTAGG(col2, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col2) FROM e GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(mcol1)
queries.expectedException: .*GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV\(\) is not supported with WITHIN GROUP ordered aggregates.*
